requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject layout-driven removal of evidence qualifications and sources
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The delivery skill forbids dropping caveats, unknowns, negative findings or sources merely to satisfy pagination.
Fidelity is invariant during document rendering and uncertainty remains part of the content contract.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: solve pagination through layout rather than content distortion
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Pagination problems are handled through layout, spacing, table and page-break adjustments rather than factual rewriting.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: remove uncertainty because it is visually inconvenient
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Uncertainty cannot be removed for visual convenience.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: change factual meaning during document production
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Document production is presentation-only and cannot alter factual meaning.
